segments.text: The Brihat Jataka holds that, with the Sun in Gemini,
a person will be learned in grammar, will be an Astrologer and will be rich.
a person will be a preacher, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.
For Mars in Pisces, the book says
a person will be fearless and of wide-spread fame
, though also with many opponents. With the Moon in Aquarius, you are
fond of flowers and perfumes; and will be attached to friends and will walk without feeling tired.

sources.text: A person born with the Sun in sign Gemini will be learned in grammar, will be an Astrologer and will be rich.
A person born with Mercury in sign Taurus or Libra will be a preacher, will have many sons and wives, will ever be engaged in earning money, will be liberal in gift and will respect his preceptor.
A person born with Mars in sign Sagittari or Pisces will have many enemies, will be the king's minister, will be of wide-spread fame, will be fearless and will have very few children.
[A person born with the Moon in sign Aquarius] will be fond of flowers and perfumes; and will be attached to friends and will walk without feeling tired.
